correctness.rationale: The stated construction works for every fixed real 0<β<1 on the bilateral shift. Zero extension preserves all interval inequalities, and a sufficiently long zero gap between any two marker words controls every interval meeting markers from both; this gives mixing for all sufficiently large gaps. The symbol at zero is detected by a fixed positive metric weight, giving expansivity. For Zhang–Ren's prescribed-position property, copy the first coordinate on each disjoint F and erase markers. A finite F with c consecutive components has c≤|∂_K F| if 1∈K, and concavity bounds the number of its markers by 3c^(1−β)|F|^β. Losing an interior observation requires a marker in its metric window, so total error is at most (η+3|W|η^(1−β))|F|. This works separately on every F, including in countable families. Fixed-gap singleton tracing would force linearly many markers, ruling out specification. Invariant marker frequency is ≤3n^(β−1) for every n and hence zero; any nonzero periodic marker sequence has positive frequency. Thus measure entropies, equilibrium states and pressure identify on the common slice under restriction of the potential, and periodic counts are 2^n, giving the stated zeta function. For complexity, the binomial upper bound and independent middle-third choices in blocks of size ceil(4n^(1−β)) give log p_β(n) of order n^β log n: separation gives at most 1+2m/s≤1+m^β/2 markers for m≤n, and longer windows see no more than the total n/s markers. P=2^n p_β, so the common entropy is log 2. A fixed coding radius changes the entropy-excess comparison only by a fixed shift in n and an additive constant; conjugacy therefore forces the exponents to agree.
residual_risks: The supplied finite checker was inspected, not executed. Its rational-parameter examples cannot establish the all-real-parameter or infinite-system claims; those were checked by proof.
Pressure is identified for potentials with matching restrictions, not for arbitrary unrelated ambient potentials.

value.rationale: Mixing, prescribed-position tracing and full-shift thermodynamic and periodic data might suggest comparable symbolic orbit structure.
